limitations: Full QA-approved regional release: all 1549 cells.
Recommendations are provisional agronomic rules, not trained-model predictions or observed crop outcomes.
Observed-label count is zero; field and agronomist validation remain required.
January 2018 has no trailing 12-month rainfall value, so scoring reweights only sufficiently covered factors.
A 5 km cell is a screening unit, not a farm boundary or yield promise.

sources.name: CHIRPS v3 Monthly
sources.role: final monthly rainfall and trailing-12-month rainfall

sources.name: CHIRPS GEE Staging
sources.role: GEE export staging only; never silently substitute it for required CHIRPS v3

sources.name: ERA5-Land
sources.role: temperature, solar radiation, and physical soil-water features

sources.name: Fao Gaul
sources.role: Myanmar national boundary and administration context

sources.name: JRC Global Surface Water
sources.role: surface-water occurrence; a static water-access proxy

sources.name: Sentinel-1 Ground Range Detected
sources.role: SAR VV/VH fallback during optical-cloud gaps

sources.name: Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance
sources.resolution: 10 m (indices); 20 m source SWIR band resampled by Earth Engine composition

sources.name: Transparent water-availability proxy
sources.role: Derived screening proxy from ERA5 soil water, JRC water proximity, and rainfall
